reviews.review: A classic of the genre, you can't go wrong picking this up
i've played this game a lot
It doesn't actually rain in this game

I can't really see the praise in it.
In theory, it would be okay, the idea of a rougelike being just one big level which you have to explore and then fight the boss when you are ready is neat. But there are just so many small things that are dealbreakers for me. (maybe most of these were looked over because it was a rather early one of the rise of rougelikes and lites?)
The level generation is whack, you are often just battling about the procedural generation alone.
the characters are absolutely tiny and some attacks are probably some pixels wide.
There is no sprint button which makes the downtime ardous when you need to revisit stores.
Enemies can just spawn inside you anytime or lock you in a bad spot so you are forced to run through them.
They can also block platforms where there is no other way through, or stuck in pits so you have to jump down to finish them, or get stuck in the jumppads and so on. Why in the world is there no "drop through floor" key?
Why can't you aim up/down and diagonally which would help so much in cases where enemies are just enough below/above you that you have to jump repeatedly to hit them which needs ages.
The items all feel pretty unremarkable.
But the worst is the combat, which basically looks like this: use all your skills, run away, wait for cooldowns, use all your skills, ...
You have to stay still to shoot as you can't run backwards, but doing so means the enemies close in on you or just spawn behind/in you, which in another game wouldn't be that big of an issue, but here it means you have to completely run away and bother with the platforms and ropes and whatnot and then there are like 15 enemies stuck on small platform and you can't properly fight them because you can't cheese them and they just gobble you.
A lot of these things could be solved with another grip of mine, the damage you deal regardless of items or levels is just pitiful. No, I don't want to play run and gun with just a jellyfish for 30 seconds to kill it while the game spawns 5 more behind it. Everything needs way too long to kill past the first few levels, and it turns all the other problems into a big issue why I can't find a lot of fun in that game.
This game is one of the best I have ever played. I Highly recommend that you play it. It deserves a lot more love than it gets. A quick warning though, it is EXTREMELY ADDICTIVELY GOOD!
